thermal.coverage: Continuous sole or whole-body coverage; never an isolated spot or thermal-only core hole. Whole-body heat chars cloth headwear and leaves soot on shell/crystals; sole heat excludes headwear. House variants directly select grade three.
thermal.shrink_rule: User: height unchanged, cheeks and lower face narrow progressively; no uniform scale. Ornaments retain dimensions and follow their attachment region. Sole burn has no drying deformation.
thermal.appearance: Wiki EH16-008 soot stipple, dry matte darkening and fine grain; no Voronoi polygons, connected crack graph or bright fracture rims.
thermal.dry_face: Character-local UV painting: grade two keeps original round pupils/iris with tired lowered eye height; grade three uses soft closed lids for open resting expressions. Preserve crying, eating and closed-eye intent. Disconnected short dry marks and muted existing lip pixels, no cheek/chin contour or skin-colored backing.

filling_material.boundary: Shared hue, shared grain, no specular shell or dark outline.
